reviewer_note: Problem is D-pad key-repeat (long-press RIGHT) on a LazyRow: every repeated KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT moves focus one card and the 25% pivot BringIntoViewSpec snaps, so the rail streams past. Correct fix: govern the repeat rate (consume repeats faster than ~one card per 150-200 ms, or a sustained-hold pace with the pivot animation completing per step), keep the focused card pinned at the pivot with a bounded per-step animation so titles stay legible, respect reduced motion (instant but still governed), no change to nav/theme/type. The ontology has no id for key-repeat / long-press scroll governance; perf.focus_latency and interaction.dpad_reachability are the nearest carriers, so a knowledge-gap on the core fix is likely.
